col_actor_desc: Who performed the action. Can be a user or "System" for automatic actions.
col_date_desc: Exact moment when the action occurred
col_details_desc: Additional information: amount, origin, destination, description, etc.
filter_hint: Select the type of action you want to view.
help_admissions_desc: Entry of new members to the node
help_federation_desc: Transactions with other nodes (imports and exports)
help_purpose_desc: Allows verifying what happened, who did it and when. It is the basis of system transparency: any member can review the complete history and audit that there are no irregularities.
help_transfers_desc: Sending and receiving of units between accounts. Shows origin and destination.
help_usage_desc: Select an action type filter to view only the records that interest you. For example, click "Transfers" to see only sent and received units.
no_entries_hint: Records appear when transfers, admissions, configuration changes, etc. are made.
